blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Medusa application related to the Pricing Module. If you use the module outside the Medusa application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: price-list.created
events.description: Emitted when price lists are created.

events.name: price-list.updated
events.description: Emitted when price lists are updated.

events.name: price-list.deleted
events.description: Emitted when price lists are deleted.

events.name: price-list.prices_added
events.description: Emitted when prices are added to a price list.

events.name: price-list.prices_updated
events.description: Emitted when prices in a price list are updated.

events.name: price-list.prices_removed
events.description: Emitted when prices are removed from a price list.
